en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as heat eases only slightly
en.dek: The Observatory expects sunny periods and one or two showers on Thursday, with urban highs around 34 degrees Celsius and continued very hot conditions across the territory.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force. A southwesterly airstream continues to affect the coast of Guangdong, keeping conditions very hot with only a slight easing of the extreme heat seen earlier in the week.

Thursday’s forecast calls for sunny periods and one or two showers. Temperatures are expected to range from 29 to 34 degrees Celsius, with relative humidity between 65 and 95 per cent. Southwest winds of force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore at first, are forecast.

The Observatory advised the public to continue drinking sufficient water, take protective measures against the heat and pay attention to physical condition. Elderly people, young children, pregnant women and those with chronic illnesses remain particularly vulnerable. Friday is expected to bring more showers and thunderstorms with slightly lower temperatures.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 極端酷熱稍為緩和
zh.dek: 天文台預料星期四部分時間有陽光及一兩陣驟雨，市區最高氣溫約34度，本港天氣仍然酷熱。
body: 香港天文台表示，酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。一股西南氣流繼續影響廣東沿岸，本港天氣仍然酷熱，極端酷熱情况稍為緩和。
星期四預料部分時間有陽光，有一兩陣驟雨。氣溫介乎29至34度，相對濕度65至95%。吹西南風4級，初時離岸間中5級。
天文台提醒市民繼續多補充水分、採取防暑措施，並留意身體狀況。長者、幼童、孕婦及長期病患者尤其需加小心。星期五預料有較多驟雨及雷暴，氣溫稍降。
